shared_elements: humanoid figure with head and torso
belt or band across the body
justification: Both depict an upright anthropomorphic figure whose torso bears a belt-like band and, in A, circular disc motifs which loosely echo the rosette-like disc on the belt/harness of B's figure. But B shows a highly detailed, naturalistic winged eagle-headed genius and a bearded winged man striding in profile with weapons and feathered wings, whereas A is a wholly schematic frontal block figure with a slab-like head, minimal features and a few incised circles and lines — different conventions, different relationships, and no shared narrative.
